system.description:
Grabbing ahold of your weapon and infusing it with your chakra allows you to make shots precise enough to avoid droplets of water during a storm while still hitting their target. For the duration, each time you roll an Ammunition Die as part of a Taijutsu attack, you can choose to instead reduce the size of your ammunition die by 1 step. If you do, the affected creature that you deal [Weapon damage] to becomes War-Marked until the end of your next turn.

| Takeminakata’s Ammo – War-Marked / A Creature that is War-Marked radiates with a soft red mist that only the creature that inflicted the mark can see. A War-Marked creature triggers attacks of opportunities against creature’s hostile to it within 10 feet of it when it spends its Action. Creatures who makes an attack of opportunity in this way, can take the Attack Action as if it were their turn. |
